name: io.github.macorifice/yeti
title: Yeti
description: Product design with Claude: phases, requirements, user stories, RICE, flows, dashboard, Jira.

environmentVariables.name: PRODUCT_DESIGN_DB
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path of the SQLite database file. Set it to a folder you keep when running with npx.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_SITE
environmentVariables.description: Jira site, e.g. https://your-team.atlassian.net. Only needed for the Jira tools.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Email of the Atlassian account. Only needed for the Jira tools.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Atlassian API token. Only needed for the Jira tools.
